meta.name: intelligence-collection-disciplines
meta.description: Run competitive research like an intelligence agency: eight collection disciplines (OSINT to MASINT), signal-to-inference chains, and fusion. Use when one-source research isn't enough.

copy.tagline: 像情报机构一样开展多源竞争调研
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果单一来源研究总让你觉得不够深入。
copy.tagline_en: Run competitive research with agency-grade collection and fusion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if single-source research feels too shallow for your decisions.

howto.what: Claude 会像情报机构一样做竞争研究：先要你明确这项研究要支撑什么决策，再按八种独立渠道（如新闻、财报、专利等）收集信号，把每个信号变成有限度的判断，最后交叉验证成结论。
howto.when: 当只用一种信息源做研究不够时触发，比如要查证竞品是否在布局新方向、核实市场规模等。若没说明研究要支撑的决策，它会先停下询问。

say.text: 帮我用八种独立信源查证一家竞品是否在布局仓储机器人，决定要不要跟进。
say.note: Claude 会分学科收集信号并交叉验证，给出判断依据。

say.text: 我想交叉验证竞品可能要涨价的判断，除了公开新闻还能从哪里查？
say.note: Claude 会列出独立信源，比对信号是否指向同一结论。

say.text: 先按目标、市场、区域等六项变量填好，再开始多源收集。
say.note: Claude 会先补全变量，避免无决策地空研究。

howto.what_en: Claude runs competitive research like an intelligence agency: asks which decision it informs, gathers signals from eight independent channels, turns each into a bounded inference, then fuses via cross-validation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when one-source research isn't enough, e.g., verifying a suspected competitor move or sizing a market. If no decision to inform is given, it stops and asks.

say_en.text: Check if a rival is entering warehouse robotics; advise on following.
say_en.note: Claude runs all disciplines, then fuses.

say_en.text: Cross-check my guess that a rival may raise prices with independent sources.
say_en.note: Claude lists independent sources and checks the signals.

say_en.text: Fill in the six variables (target, market, region, etc.) first.
say_en.note: It asks for missing variables first.
